latest_release.body:
### Patch Changes

- [#177](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/177) [`c4cf640`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/c4cf640a91afee235e4461bb06d44751b7991688) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Follow a call to a `cva` or `tv` result defined in the same file, so `no-restyle` checks every variant it can produce and `require-static-classes` no longer reports it as dynamic.

- [#172](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/172) [`19eee07`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/19eee07d319c6ba3fdbdf20b541af2e546b9f1c1) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Leave a plain element alone when it is the `render` target of a component that adds no classes, such as a `PopoverTrigger` that only spreads its props onto Base UI, so `no-restyle` and `require-static-classes` no longer judge it by that component.

- [#164](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/164) [`f0586bf`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/f0586bfa87da80a89a3a4e3c6ce52eacef81a529) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Stop warning about a contract entry the theme's Tailwind build generates, such as `prose` from a plugin.

- [#162](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/162) [`0fd4874`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/0fd487474a451935ab518fa7ce24ac4c9dc05d52) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Stop reading `data-*` and `aria-*` attributes such as `data-class` as class lists.

- [#168](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/168) [`d26410c`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/d26410c7a389440be6f6a63ddf92416bb8fbc556) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Read a component's variants and sizes from a `buttonVariants` factory it imports from another project module, through a relative path or an alias.

- [#176](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/176) [`d5e6111`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/d5e6111ac7ed8837bb66c84454cac469be7dc700) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Resolve `<X.Member>` through its namespace before joining names, so a re-exported package's raw parts are no longer judged as the ui component their joined name matches.

- [#170](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/170) [`0c421e1`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/0c421e1f442f2a3eadf952d9dc17f2dafcebba2c) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Recognize a component that `settings.shadcn.ui` names when it's imported through the app's own barrel, as a `components.json` ui directory already was.

- [#166](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/166) [`9231259`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/92312596a972432e66d2bfde86be9a0bd0a2fbe2) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Keep the numeric spacing scale when a theme sets `--spacing` after `--*: initial` or `--spacing-*: initial`, so `p-4` stays a spacing and `border-spacing-0` is no longer reported as an undeclared color.

- [#169](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/169) [`2af84e3`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/2af84e3f08dcf1605d45882051d99e1d209cb8e2) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Resolve a theme's `@import` the way Tailwind does, through a package's `style` condition or field, so `@import "tailwindcss"` reads its stylesheet instead of `dist/lib.mjs` and names from the JavaScript bundle no longer count as known classes.

- [#165](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/165) [`1940709`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/19407096570e2579beae45a514008db17b657bf7) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Wait longer for a slow Tailwind worker, and warn when a worker failure falls back to the bundled grammar. Set `SHADCN_LINT_TAILWIND_TIMEOUT` in milliseconds to change the wait.

- [#167](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/pull/167) [`dd47489`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/commit/dd47489bded7d9a13de04873624808a137919ce3) Thanks [@shadcn](https://github.com/shadcn)! - Read tsconfig `paths` from a root `tsconfig.base.json`, as in an Nx workspace, when the root `tsconfig.json` or `jsco

detail.readme: # @shadcn/lint **Write design system rules that agents can verify.** `@shadcn/lint` is an [agent-first linter](#built-for-agents) for Tailwind design systems. You define what’s allowed. When an agent breaks a rule, the error explains what’s wrong and suggests a fix based on your components, variants, and theme. **Works with your existing design system. No rewrite required.** `@shadcn/lint` works with Tailwind v4 projects (**shadcn/ui not required**). Available for both **ESLint and Oxlint**. Works with **React, Svelte, and Vue**. ## Table of contents - [Quickstart](#quickstart) - [TypeScript vs @shadcn/lint](#typescript-vs-shadcnlint) - [Built for agents](#built-for-agents) - [Get started](#get-started) - [Rules](#rules) - [Frameworks](#frameworks) - [Configuration](#settings) ## Quickstart Give your coding agent this prompt: ```text Read https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/blob/main/SETUP.md and set up @shadcn/lint in this project. ``` Once installed, [choose your rules](#rules) and configure what’s allowed in your design system. Prefer to configure it yourself? See [Get started](#get-started). ## TypeScript vs @shadcn/lint Take a Button that allows margin and width, but controls its own padding. You can enforce that with types by limiting its `style` prop to `Pick`. ```tsx ``` ```text TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'padding' does not exist in type 'Pick'. ``` The rule works. But this error only tells the agent that padding is not allowed. It doesn’t tell it how to size the Button. With `@shadcn/lint`, the same rule comes with **guidance from your design system**: ```tsx ``` ```text "p-4" is not allowed on ``` It sees: ```text Use the size prop instead of padding. ``` ### Placeholders Use your component’s sizes, variants, and file paths in error messages. For spacing errors, `{{sizes}}` lists the available sizes: ```js "shadcn/no-restyle": ["error", { allow: ["layout"], message: { spacing: "Use a {{component}} size: {{sizes}}.", }, }] ``` For a Button with `sm` and `lg` sizes, the error becomes: ```text Use a Button size: sm, lg. ``` You can also tell agents where to find theme colors. For example, in `no-raw-colors`: ```js message: "Use a theme color from {{file}}." ``` If your theme is in `src/index.css`, the error becomes: ```text Use a theme color from src/index.css. ``` See all [message placeholders](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#your-own-words). ### Contracts Give each component its own rules. For example, let pages change a card title's typography: ```js "shadcn/no-restyle": ["error", { allow: ["layout"], contracts: [ { pattern: "^CardTitle$", allow: ["layout", "typography"] }, ], }] ``` ```tsx // Allowed by the contract. Account settings // Reported: the contract does not allow color overrides. Account settings ``` See [contracts and custom messages](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint/blob/main/docs/design-systems.md). ## Get started Requires Node.js 20.19 or later and a version supported by your linter. Bun 1.3 or later works too, with `bun lint` or `bun --bun lint`. ### React #### ESLint Requires ESLint 9.30 or later. ```bash npm install -D @shadcn/lint eslint @typescript-eslint/parser ``` Create `eslint.config.mjs`. If your framework already configures ESLint, keep its parser setup and add the plugin, rule, and component override. ```js import { plugin as shadcn } from "@shadcn/lint" import tsParser from "@typescript-eslint/parser" import { defineConfig } from "eslint/config" export default defineConfig([ { files: ["**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}"], languageOptions: { parser: tsParser, parserOptions: { ecmaFeatures: { jsx: true } }, }, plugins: { shadcn }, rules: { "shadcn/no-arbitrary-values": "error", }, }, ]) ``` ```bash npx eslint . ``` #### Oxlint Requires Oxlint 1.80 or later. ```bash npm install -D @shadcn/lint oxlint ``` Create `.oxlintrc.json`: ```json { "jsPlugins": ["@shadcn/lint"], "rules": { "shadcn/no-arbitrary-values": "error" } } ``` ```bash npx oxlint ``` ### Vue #### ESLint Requires ESLint 9.30 or later. ```bash npm install -D @shadcn/lint eslint @typescript-eslint/parser vue-eslint-parser ``` Create `eslint.config.mjs`. If you already use `eslint-plugin-vue`, keep its parser setup and add the plugin and rule to that block. ```js import { plugin as shadcn } from "@shadcn/lint" import tsParser from "@typescript-eslint/parser" import { defineConfig } from "eslint/config" import vueParser from "vue-eslint-parser" export default defineConfig([ { files: ["**/*.vue"], languageOptions: { parser: vueParser, parserOptions: { parser: tsParser }, }, plugins: { shadcn }, rules: { "shadcn/no-arbitrary-values": "error", }, }, ]) ``` ```bash npx eslint . ``` #### Oxlint Requires Oxlint 1.80 or later.
